description: Woman living at the time of the New Testament

cases.name: Ananias and Sapphira
cases.charge: Vowing a possession to the Lord, keeping back part of the price, and lying to the Holy Ghost about it
cases.preview: Ananias, with his wife Sapphira knowing of it, sold a possession, kept back part of the price, and laid the remainder at the apostles’ feet as though it were the whole (Acts 5:1-2).
